extracted.intended_audience: companies, investors, policymakers, and subnational governments (cities, states, regions) considering environmental disclosure through CDP
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and informational content about disclosing environmental data to CDP, using CDP data, and understanding CDP scoring and the annual disclosure cycle (including questionnaire changes). Targeted at organisations deciding whether and how to disclose and stakeholders using that data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure through CDP
rubrics_metrics.description: I want to disclose data; Disclosure Cycle 2026 — Find the latest information, key dates and guidance throughout the 2026 disclosure cycle, including details about changes to the CDP questionnaire to support organizations navigating an increasingly complex global landscape.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages organisations to follow the annual disclosure cycle and questionnaire; highlights that 23,100+ companies, cities, states, and regions disclosed through CDP in 2025 and that companies representing two‑thirds of global market capitalization disclose critical environmental data through CDP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Turning data into Earth-positive impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Turning data into Earth-positive impact. Why use data? The data surfaced through CDP provides companies, investors and policymakers with the crucial insights they need to make informed, Earth-positive decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises that disclosure should enable decision-making and action — use CDP reports, policy briefings, articles and case studies to translate transparency into impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scores and A Lists (public corporate scores)
rubrics_metrics.description: Scores and A Lists 2025 — Explore our latest A Lists and public corporate scores.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CDP produces public corporate scores and A Lists that surface disclosed data and are used by companies, investors and policymakers to assess performance; implies score-based comparatives are a primary evaluative mechanism.

rubrics_metrics.name: CDP questionnaire and reporting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Details about changes to the CDP questionnaire to support organizations navigating an increasingly complex global landscape.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The questionnaire content and any yearly changes constitute the operational criteria for what organisations must report; follow guidance and key dates in the disclosure cycle to meet reporting expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Measured emissions impact from disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Within two years of an investor request, companies disclosing through CDP reduce their direct emissions by 7-10% on average.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as evidence of the efficacy of disclosure — a performance outcome metric that stakeholders can cite when evaluating the value of participating in CDP disclosure.
